FACT_ID: sec14-R01 | anchor: A173
After a blowout you let the car slow by itself and brake only gently if needed, rather than braking firmly as you might for a hazard ahead. [A173]
Why it matters: group_hint failures; prereq_hint sec14-F01; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec14-F04.
Source: [A173 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0173]

FACT_ID: sec14-R02 | anchor: A174
A dead engine calls for steady brake pressure and pulling off, while a stuck accelerator calls for shifting quickly into neutral before pulling off and shutting the engine down. [A174]
Why it matters: group_hint failures; prereq_hint sec14-R01; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec14-F06, sec14-F09.
Source: [A174 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0174]

FACT_ID: sec14-R03 | anchor: A173
Breakdown flares go 200 to 300 feet behind your vehicle, and with no flares you wave traffic around from a safe place instead. [A173]
Why it matters: group_hint breakdown-warning; prereq_hint sec14-F01; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec14-F02, sec14-F03.
Source: [A173 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0173]

FACT_ID: sec14-R04 | anchor: A178
The 35-foot figure appears twice: it is how far bystanders should stay from an energized vehicle and how far you shuffle after jumping clear of one. [A178]
Why it matters: group_hint power-lines; prereq_hint sec14-F25; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec14-F27, sec14-F28.
Source: [A178 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0178]

FACT_ID: sec14-R05 | anchor: A178
Staying inside is the rule for any power line contact, including driving over one, and the only exit the guide describes is jumping clear when a fire starts. [A178]
Why it matters: group_hint power-lines; prereq_hint sec14-R04; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec14-F25, sec14-F26, sec14-F28.
Source: [A178 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0178]

FACT_ID: sec14-R06 | anchor: A176
The collision report deadline is 4 days and applies only when a police officer does not file the report for you. [A176]
Why it matters: group_hint crash-reporting; prereq_hint sec14-F17; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec14-F18.
Source: [A176 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0176]

FACT_ID: sec14-R07 | anchor: A176
Hitting a parked car means first trying to find its owner, and leaving a note with date, time and contact details is the fallback when you cannot. [A176]
Why it matters: group_hint crash-reporting; prereq_hint sec14-F13; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec14-F16.
Source: [A176 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0176]

FACT_ID: sec14-R08 | anchor: A182
The ticket response window is 15 days to avoid suspension, and signing the ticket is required but is not an admission of guilt. [A182]
Why it matters: group_hint tickets; prereq_hint sec14-F36; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec14-F38, sec14-F39.
Source: [A182 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0182]

FACT_ID: sec14-R09 | anchor: A182
Disagreeing with an officer's decision is handled by contesting it in court, while a concern about the officer's conduct goes to the officer's agency with a request for a supervisor. [A182]
Why it matters: group_hint tickets; prereq_hint sec14-F37; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec14-F37.
Source: [A182 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0182]

FACT_ID: sec14-R10 | anchor: A181
At a traffic stop you tell the officer where your documents are and wait for instructions before reaching, rather than reaching for them first. [A181]
Why it matters: group_hint traffic-stop; prereq_hint sec14-F32; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec14-F35, sec14-F36.
Source: [A181 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0181]

FACT_ID: sec14-R11 | anchor: A177
Breathing is checked before bleeding, and for bleeding hand pressure comes before a dressing, with a tourniquet listed last. [A177]
Why it matters: group_hint injuries; prereq_hint sec14-F19; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec14-F20, sec14-F21.
Source: [A177 -> src:rdmv-wa-s:washington-state-department-of-licensing:handbook:pdf-0177]
